Title: New reference data options in Stream Analytics—SQL Managed Instance and SQL Server on VM

Body.Content:
It's now possible to configure an Azure SQL Database Managed Instance or even a SQL server running on a virtual machine as a reference data input for you Stream Analytics job. When you finish configuring and adding these inputs and outputs in your job, Stream Analytics will automatically test the connection to these resources to ensure everything is set up correctly.

Learn more
